errors.text: The intervention is not a single defined treatment: neither the alloying element nor its concentration is specified, whereas the target intervention is addition of 4.2 at.% Cr by vacuum arc melting.
The proposed tensile testing through 1000 °C does not match the target room-temperature compression conditions.
The hypothesis omits the approximately 4 vol.% reticulated Cr2(Ti,Zr,Hf,Ta) Laves phase, which is the key structural mediator.
The proposed grain-refinement mechanism is unsupported and misses both Cr-induced lattice distortion/dislocation hardening and crack hindrance by the interconnected Laves phase.
The elevated-temperature strength and density thresholds are not supported by the supplied RHEA evidence or by the target result.
